prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable word 135px · one-line width 135px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 78px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 135px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 1145px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"供读者识别常用化学试剂，并查阅其纯度和储存要求。","reading":"读者先按名称定位试剂，再横向核对分子式、CAS 号和纯度，最后阅读储存条件；储存说明较长，通常决定行高。","groups":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号共同用于识别试剂，其中后两列是需要准确核对的标识。","纯度和储存条件描述试剂规格与保管要求，需与同一行的试剂保持清晰对应。"],"keep_intact":["分子式及其下标、结晶水记法","CAS 号","纯度百分比和范围","名称尽量完整，尤其是较长的乙二胺四乙酸二钠"],"may_wrap":["储存条件可在自然语义位置换行，其产生的行高也可容纳同一行其他单元格的换行。","纯度等级与百分比之间可以换行。","空间紧张时，较长的中文试剂名称可以换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [144, 156, 99, 115, 205] · table 720×1221px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 176, 176, 153, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [120, 156, 99, 156, 188] · table 720×1407px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 199, 199, 176, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [100, 156, 99, 100, 264] · table 720×942px · row heights [36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"名称、分子式和 CAS 号均保持完整，纯度等级与数值分行后仍易于核对；各行边界清楚。","problems":"储存说明过于狭长，多数行有七行文字，其他列留下大片空白，跨列对应的阅读节奏被拉长。","cause":"名称列 144px 可完整容纳最长名称，但与 115px 的纯度列一起占用了储存列空间，使储存列仅有 205px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"纯度等级和数值保持在同一行，分子式及 CAS 号也完整，规格信息便于快速扫描。","problems":"储存说明成为很窄的文字带，行高显著增加，左侧空白过多；最长名称换行，而省下的空间主要用于保持纯度单行，收益不成比例。","cause":"纯度列增至 156px、名称列为 120px，储存列因此只剩 188px，说明多达八行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"储存列较宽，说明的行长和行高更舒适；各行高度一致，分子式、CAS 号和纯度数值保持完整，整体扫描节奏最好。","problems":"最长名称在“乙二胺四乙／酸二钠”处分行，识别时需要多看一眼；纯度统一占两行，但同一行已有足够高度，因此影响较小。","cause":"名称列仅 100px，文字区约 79px，不足以容纳最长名称；纯度列同为 100px，无法同时容纳等级和百分比。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1C-balanced","widths":[115,156,99,100,249],"change":"以 r0C 为基础，将名称列加宽 15px，尝试改善最长名称的断行位置；储存列仍保留 249px，维持较舒适的说明行长。"},{"name":"r1C-name","widths":[144,156,99,96,224],"change":"让最长名称完整占一行，纯度允许在等级与数值之间换行；储存列比 r0A 宽，检验完整名称与说明行长之间的折中。"},{"name":"r1C-storage","widths":[100,156,99,90,274],"change":"保留 r0C 的名称折行，将纯度列缩至仍可容纳百分比范围的宽度，把节省的空间分给储存说明，检验更宽说明列能否改善断行和阅读节奏。"}]}
